design_rationale: Participants were explicitly assigned 1:1 using codes generated by an independent epidemiologist from a random number table, so this is a randomized controlled trial.

domain_judgments.rationale: The sequence was generated with a random number table by an independent epidemiologist, allocation was concealed by independent pharmacy staff until study completion, and reported baseline characteristics were broadly similar.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: An independent epidemiologist generated a series of randomization codes for varicella zoster vaccine solution or distilled water based on a random number table... The contents of the code were concealed by the independent research staff until the study was completed.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants and administering medical staff were blinded using identically appearing preparations, no important intervention deviations were reported, and the primary outcome was analyzed by intention to treat.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Pharmacists produced a vaccine solution or purified distilled water that were identical in appearance... [the medical staff member] was blinded to the contents of the codes... The primary endpoints of cell-mediated immunity and safety analyses were used in the intention-to-treat (ITT) population.

domain_judgments.rationale: Only two of 54 participants lacked complete follow-up, but the primary analysis imputed missing outcomes with last observation carried forward, which may introduce bias despite the small amount of missingness.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: During followup, one participant was unable to visit the hospital and another died of acute cardiac insufficiency... Missing values for the primary endpoint were imputed using a last observation carried forward method.

domain_judgments.rationale: The prespecified skin-test outcome used standardized criteria and timing in both groups, but the report does not clearly state whether the person reading the partly judgment-dependent skin reaction remained blinded to allocation.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Skin test reactions with varicella virus antigen were performed 0 and 3 months after vaccination... The long diameter was used as the diameter value. The reaction criteria were as follows: negative (score 0), < 5 mm; weakly positive (score 1), 5–9 mm; moderately positive (score 2), 10–14 mm; and strongly positive (score 3), ≥ 10 mm with double redness or induration reaction.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was registered and the primary outcome was identified, but no protocol or prespecified statistical analysis plan is provided to verify that the reported outcome scoring and analyses were selected without flexibility.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This trial was registered with the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, Japan (UMIN000004771)... The primary outcome measure was the change in cell-mediated immunity at 3 months after vaccination, as measured by the varicella skin test reaction.

overall_summary: The randomized, concealed, double-blind design and near-complete follow-up support validity. Some concerns remain because missing primary outcomes were handled using last observation carried forward, outcome-assessor blinding was not explicit, and prespecified analysis details could not be fully verified.

design_rationale: The Methods explicitly state that 101 enrolled subjects were randomized 1:1 to two vaccine/placebo administration sequences in a double-blind crossover trial.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although allocation was explicitly randomized and stratified, the sequence-generation and allocation-concealment methods were not reported, and there was a notable baseline sex imbalance (70.6% versus 48.0% female).
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A total of 101 subjects, 50 years of age with a history of HZ 5 years prior to screening, were enrolled and randomized in a 1:1 ratio to one of two vaccination groups.

domain_judgments.rationale: Vaccine and placebo were indistinguishable and the trial was double blind, making differential deviations unlikely, but immunogenicity was analyzed per protocol rather than by randomized assignment and one participant withdrew before the second dose.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The lyophilized zoster vaccine ... and placebo ... were indistinguishable from each other.

domain_judgments.rationale: Follow-up and immunogenicity data were available for nearly all randomized participants, with only one withdrawal and similarly small amounts of missing data across treatment periods, making material bias unlikely.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: 100% (51/51) of the subjects randomized to Group 1 and 98.0% (49/50) of subjects randomized to Group 2 completed all study visits.

domain_judgments.rationale: Immunogenicity was measured objectively with the same gpELISA method across conditions, while adverse events were collected systematically using a vaccination report card in a double-blind trial with indistinguishable injections.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Blood samples were drawn on day 1, week 4, and week 8 postenrollment and tested for VZV antibody titer by gpELISA.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was registered and its primary and secondary objectives and principal analyses were described, but no prospective protocol or statistical analysis plan is provided to verify that reported outcome definitions, subgroup analyses, and analytic choices were prespecified.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The purpose of this study (NCT00322231) was to determine the safety profile and immunogenicity of zoster vaccine in individuals who experienced a prior episode of HZ.

overall_summary: Overall risk of bias is some concerns. The trial was randomized, double blind, had nearly complete follow-up, and used objective immunogenicity measurement, but sequence generation and allocation concealment were not described, immunogenicity analyses were per protocol, and prospective documentation was insufficient to exclude selective reporting.

design_rationale: The study explicitly used 1:1 random assignment according to a computer-generated, study-center-specific allocation schedule.

domain_judgments.rationale: The allocation sequence was computer-generated by an independent sponsor statistician, assigned sequentially by center, and concealed using subject-specific materials prepared by a coordinator who had no participant contact.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Subjects were randomized in a 1:1 ratio to receive 2 doses of either ZV or placebo, according to a computer-generated, study-center specific allocation schedule.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants and relevant study personnel were blinded and no important protocol deviations were reported, but one randomized participant was excluded and immunogenicity was analyzed per protocol rather than clearly by intention to treat.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: One subject in the ZV group was randomized, but not vaccinated, and was not included in the analyses.

domain_judgments.rationale: Substantial immunogenicity data were missing, particularly for the primary six-week post-dose-2 endpoint (68/104 vaccine and 72/105 placebo), and the paper did not establish that missingness was unrelated to outcomes or provide a sensitivity analysis.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: 6 weeks postvaccination 2 ... GMC ... 68 [zoster vaccine] ... 72 [placebo].

domain_judgments.rationale: Immunogenicity outcomes were measured with validated objective laboratory assays using standardized handling, with participant samples generally tested together, while study personnel were blinded to treatment assignment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: PBMC were frozen, stored in liquid nitrogen freezer, shipped encased in dry ice to a central laboratory, and then stored in a liquid nitrogen freezer until testing in a validated IFN-γ ELISPOT assay.

domain_judgments.rationale: The paper identifies prespecified primary endpoints and multiplicity adjustment, but no protocol or statistical analysis plan is provided for verification, and numerous secondary time points and operationalizations were analyzed.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary immunogenicity endpoints were the VZV IFN-γ ELISPOT geometric mean counts (GMCs) at 6 weeks after each dose of ZV.

overall_summary: Overall risk of bias is high because substantial outcome data were missing for the primary immunogenicity endpoint without evidence that missingness could not bias the result. Additional concerns arise from per-protocol analyses and the inability to verify selective reporting against a protocol or prespecified analysis plan.

design_rationale: The Methods explicitly describe a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial assigning 38,546 adults to zoster vaccine or placebo.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although the trial is explicitly randomized and the groups were well balanced at baseline, the main report does not describe how the allocation sequence was generated or concealed until assignment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: We conducted a randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind clinical trial at 22 sites, in which adults 60 years of age or older received either VZV vaccine or placebo.

domain_judgments.rationale: Double blinding, similar co-intervention use, and protocol-based care reduce concern, but the primary efficacy analysis was modified intention-to-treat and excluded withdrawals and early post-randomization cases rather than retaining all randomized participants.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Efficacy analyses were performed with the use of a follow-up period that excluded the first 30 days after vaccination and excluded subjects who withdrew and those in whom a confirmed case of herpes zoster developed within the first 30 days after vaccination.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome surveillance was available for nearly all participants, follow-up duration was equal between groups, and withdrawal or loss to follow-up was only 0.6%, making material bias from missing outcomes unlikely.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: More than 95 percent of the subjects were actively followed to the end of the study... Only 0.6 percent of the subjects withdrew from the study or were lost to follow-up; 4.1 percent died during the study.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were assessed consistently using prespecified clinical and laboratory criteria, a standardized pain instrument, and adjudication before unblinding, so differential measurement is unlikely.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Before unblinding, each suspected case of herpes zoster was classified as a confirmed case of herpes zoster or as not a confirmed case with the use of a hierarchical algorithm that incorporated the results of the polymerase-chain-reaction (PCR) assay... virus culture... and the final clinical diagnosis of the study’s clinical evaluation committee.

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary and secondary endpoints, success criteria, and analysis plan were prespecified before unblinding, and the reported primary results correspond to those plans, limiting scope for selective reporting.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A data-analysis plan was completed before the data were unblinded for analysis.

overall_summary: Overall risk of bias is some concerns, driven by absent details on sequence generation and allocation concealment and use of a modified intention-to-treat efficacy analysis excluding withdrawals and cases occurring within 30 days. Missing data, outcome ascertainment, and prespecified reporting otherwise appear robust.
